_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, evidence, baseline); extra fields are ignored by skill-creator's runner. Rules: protocol/TESTING.md.

evals.prompt: My game's background music clicks every time it loops. How do I fix it?
Make an 8 bar seamless loop at 96 bpm from this track for my Unity game.
My platformer has a beat chart with a music row for each level. Which music cues do I need, and is one track per world enough?
Score my 45 second trailer so the music hits the logo reveal.
expectations: the musicwright-game skill is not invoked (musicwright-score owns film)

evals.prompt: How do I make my Unity character jump?
expectations: the musicwright-game skill is not invoked (game code, not music)

evals.prompt: Cut a 4-bar loop at 120 bpm from tests/fixtures/tone.wav into loop.wav and check its seam.
expectations: the action happened, proven by the trace or the file, not by the reply

evals.prompt: How do I play an intro once and then loop the rest of a track in Unity?
expectations: says to ship two clips because Unity cannot loop from file metadata

evals.prompt: Here is my game's level plan: LEVEL-PLAN.md. Write the music cue list for the game into cues.md: which cues I need, where each plays, and anything in the plan's music column I should change.
expectations: cues.md exists and flags that stages 2 and 3 play the same woods theme back to back (regex on cues.md: (?is)(stage 2|woods).{0,400}(stage 3|deep woods).{0,400}(same|repeat|twice|back to back|rotat|alternat|second track|variant)|(?is)(same|repeat|twice|back to back|rotat|alternat).{0,300}(stage 2|woods).{0,200}(stage 3|deep woods))
cues.md gives a warning cue to a new enemy's first appearance (regex on cues.md: (?i)warning)
cues.md gives the Warden a motif reused before the boss (regex on cues.md: (?i)(motif|leitmotif))
cues.md asks for a visual twin for a cue that carries information (regex on cues.md: (?i)(visual|on.screen|on screen|deaf|hard of hearing|can.t hear|cannot hear))
